justification: Daniel Jones got his week to respond, same as Mark Andrews did, and I said at the time I wasn't going to bury a guy over one rough stretch - well, they both had their second chance and neither one answered the bell, so this week the job goes to the man who's earned it everywhere he's been. Kirk Cousins has been a pro since the day we claimed him, he's going to go out there and do his job, and that's worth more to me than chasing a number on a sheet. Everybody else stays put - Andrews and Wan'Dale had quiet Sundays but I didn't see anybody dog it out there, and I'm not going to bench a man for effort I can't fault; St. Brown says he's good to go and I trust a player's own word over a tag. Clear eyes, full hearts - we're 0-7 but we're still building this the right way.
